test_df_item: test the DataFrame.item() method returns a scalar value from a 1x1 DataFrame
test_df_item_empty: test the DataFrame.item() method raises ValueError on an empty DataFrame
test_df_item_incorrect_shape: test the DataFrame.item() method raises ValueError when DataFrame shape is not 1x1
test_df_item_with_indices: test the DataFrame.item(row, col) method retrieves values by row and column indices
test_df_item_out_of_bounds: test the DataFrame.item() method raises IndexError for out-of-bounds row or column indices
